jobs.title: CCTV Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about security technology and ensuring the safety of others? We're seeking a skilled CCTV Technician to join our team. As a CCTV Technician, you'll be responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting closed\-circuit television (CCTV) systems for our clients. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to quality will play a crucial role in safeguarding our clients' properties and assets.

Responsibilities:

* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV systems, including cameras, monitors, recording equipment, and networking components.
* Conduct site surveys to assess security needs and determine the most effective placement of CCTV equipment.
* Program and integrate CCTV systems with other security systems, such as access control and alarms, to provide comprehensive security solutions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues with CCTV equipment, including diagnosing and resolving hardware and software problems.
* Perform routine maintenance and inspections of CCTV systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* Provide training and support to clients on the operation and maintenance of CCTV systems.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, advancements, and best practices in CCTV technology.

Requirements:

* Proven experience as a CCTV Technician or similar role.
* Proficiency in installing and configuring CCTV equipment and software.
* Strong understanding of networking principles and IP\-based CCTV systems.
* Familiarity with different types of CCTV cameras, lenses, and accessories.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CCTV Installation Certification) are a plus.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

Join our team and play a key role in enhancing the security and safety of our clients' environments. Apply now to become our next CCTV Technician!

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Admission Counsellor
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Head of Admissions, you will act as Admissions Executive representing ISSM to prospective students and organizations and work to increase inquiries and convert applications into enrolled students. The successful admissions Executive exhibits superior customer service skills and professionalism throughout daily interactions and communications with students including interviews, phone calls, emails and information sessions. The Executive creates and implements strategies to reach prospective students through events, referrals, online and print communications, and outreaches to business and organization.

Responsibilities and Duties:

Highlighting the benefits of MBA/PGPM programs, explain about admission procedures and courses offered to the prospective students and their parents through phone calls, emails and face to face meetings.

Support the students throughout the admission process by answering to their queries and helping them to complete the required documents.

Maintain regular communication with students, parents, colleagues and external agencies for coordinating admission activities and resolving problems.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Minimum Bachelor's qualification required.
